description: This header file declares external functions with C linkage, involving various parameter qualifiers such as const, volatile, and restrict, as well as functions returning references and rvalue references.

methods.name: ConstParameter
methods.description: Function accepting a reference to a 2-character array.

methods.name: VolatileParameter
methods.description: Function accepting a volatile rvalue reference to a Struct.

methods.name: Restrict
methods.description: Function accepting a pointer to a char with restrict qualifier.

methods.name: MultipleConst
methods.description: Function accepting a pointer to a constant pointer to a constant char array.

methods.name: ConstReturn
methods.description: Function returning a reference to a char.

methods.name: VolatileReturn
methods.description: Function returning an rvalue reference to a Struct.
